assumptions_checked: iid candidates with p(correct)=.1; all correct candidates have identical objective reasoning quality
all correct candidates share one correct final answer; all incorrect candidates one wrong final answer
50 independent Bernoulli(.7) approval trials per correct candidate and Bernoulli(.6) per wrong candidate
generator and verifier laws fixed across k
